maria: Quick PR ping — opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/7891. Small schema change + backfill for event_summary to speed up recent CTE-heavy queries. Can someone take a look? This touches migrations + the streaming ETL so want eyes from infra/data. TL;DR: add a partial index on (event_ts) WHERE event_type = 'model_call' and a batched backfill (~200k rows). I included a non-blocking migration plan.

jonah: on it, sharing time now. can you paste the migration SQL and the backfill pattern here? also what's the expected lock behavior on prod replicas?

maria: SQL below — runs in a transaction per batch, uses CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY for pg. No global locks expected, backfill done in 10k row batches. We tested on staging.

```sql
-- migration: add partial index
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_event_summary_model_call_ts
  ON event_summary (event_ts)
  WHERE event_type = 'model_call';

-- backfill (example batch)
BEGIN;
  WITH cte AS (
    SELECT id FROM event_summary
    WHERE metrics_col IS NULL AND event_type = 'model_call'
    ORDER BY event_ts
    LIMIT 10000
  )
  UPDATE event_summary
  SET metrics_col = compute_metrics(payload)
  FROM cte
  WHERE event_summary.id = cte.id;
COMMIT;
```

db-ops-bot: schema-lint: check passed with one advisory (use of CONCURRENTLY may leave dangling index if aborted). See /lint-report/7891

anya: quick q — what if we hit a timeout mid-backfill? do we have an idempotent resume? also who runs the backfill job in prod (infra or data-platform)?

maria: backfill is idempotent — we only update rows where metrics_col IS NULL. If a batch times out we retry from last max(id) checkpoint; script checkpoints via a job table. We'll coordinate run from data-platform but infra can help if we need to throttle.

sam: please add a short runbook in the PR describing the rollout steps, checkpoint table name, and the metric to watch (backfill_rate, p99 write latency). Also add a canary: run 1 batch against prod shard-1 first.

maria: will add runbook section and a canary step. current plan: merge after 2 approvals, schedule backfill window 02:00–04:00 UTC, start with canary batch, monitor p99 write and replica lag. Estimated total runtime ~20–45 minutes depending on throttling.

kevin: quick perf note — after creating the partial index, please run ANALYZE on the table for the planner to pick it up. also ensure we have a rollback step: DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_event_summary_model_call_ts if needed.

maria: good call, will include ANALYZE in the post-migration task and explicit DROP in rollback section. Tests: unit + integration passed on staging; soak job ran for 6h no errors. attaching logs in PR.

jonah: I skimmed the SQL + runbook, looks reasonable. leaving formal review in the PR, but :+1: from me for infra concerns. I'll approve if CI passes.

maria: thanks! aiming to merge at 16:30 UTC today if no other blockers. tagging @data-platform for the production run.

kevin: approved from perf side, keep me posted if you need to bump maintenance windows.

maria: noted — merging only after approvals and the runbook additions. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
